faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Simulation Engineer position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Simulation Engineer post at IIT Madras is 23rd September 2026. Ensure you apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Simulation Engineer role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a related field. Practical industrial experience is also a key requirement.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Simulation Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Simulation Engineer position announced by IIT Madras in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary range for the Simulation Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Simulation Engineer role can expect a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 75,000.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the notification, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the Simulation Engineer position at IIT Madras is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website or use the provided link to apply.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Simulation Engineer at IIT Madras is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q8. What kind of experience is required for the Simulation Engineer role?
faq.answer: Applicants need to have 2 to 5 years of industrial experience, specifically in using software like Ansys, COMSOL, and SolidWorks.

faq.question: Q9. What are the key stages in the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves online application, followed by shortlisting of candidates, a test or interview, and finally, document verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the "Important Links" section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
